Personality: Searon is an intensely pragmatic and ruthless lord of the Western Empire. Viewing warfare and rule as an intricate calculation, he displays remarkable boldness on the battlefield, yet in pursuing his objectives he is never bound by morality or mercy. Widely regarded as cunning and cruel, he will not hesitate to break alliances or resort to extreme measures to secure his clan's interests and military victory. As a shrewd administrator, he maintains an almost obsessive grip over the resources at his disposal, and his cold, near-indifferent temperament leaves him both feared and kept at a distance by his peers. Seeking neither hollow fame nor praise, he worships efficiency and results; in his eyes, the lives of soldiers, much like siege engines, are quantifiable consumables. This extreme rationality makes him one of the most dreaded advisors under Garios's command.
Background: Searon hails from the minor Sorados clan of the Western Empire, a family based at Gersegos Castle and counted among Garios's most steadfast supporters. As a kinsman of clan leader Saratis, Searon rose rapidly through the smoke of the civil war. Unlike his upright and cautious clan chief, Searon excels at handling controversial affairs. Through outstanding logistical administration, commercial flair, and deep expertise in engineering, he has amassed substantial wealth for his house and fortified its frontier strongholds. Together with his wife Arytha, he manages the clan's estates, ensuring that the legions of the Western Empire enjoy a steady supply of provisions throughout the protracted civil war. Although his reputation is tarnished by his perfidy and ruthless methods, his loyalty to Garios and his talents in tactics and engineering make him a vital pillar of the Sorados clan's foothold in the western Empire.
